provenance: BRUDEX paper (Fejgin, Middelberg, Doclo, 2023, SP2023_14.pdf, section 3): 'The multi-channel speech recordings correspond to two female and two male English speech signals (duration: 20 or 30 s) from the SQAM and VCTK corpus [26, 27].' Every model here was trained or tuned only on LibriSpeech (train-clean-100 for Gen19/Gen32; dev-clean for evaluation panels), which is derived from LibriVox audiobooks. SQAM (EBU Sound Quality Assessment Material) and VCTK (CSTR) are different corpora, so no BRUDEX recording is a LibriSpeech recording.
supporting_measurement: The BRUDEX clean talkers are 48 kHz recordings with energy in 8.2-12 kHz at -0.7, -4.4, -7.1, -10.7 dB re 4-7.8 kHz (speaker_1..4), consistent with non-LibriSpeech (16 kHz) sources. This is supporting evidence only; bandwidth cannot establish speaker independence (Astra).
speaker_identity_note: Whether a SQAM or VCTK talker is also a LibriVox reader in LibriSpeech cannot be verified here; recorded as a limitation, not a pass.
